## Owning work

- Owning issue:
- Target milestone:
- Release plan: `docs/releases/plan.json`

## Release impact

- [ ] No product-version impact
- [ ] Patch: backward-compatible fix only
- [ ] Minor: new backward-compatible capability scenario
- [ ] Major: breaking scenario with migration acceptance
- [ ] Initial or stabilization release

## Acceptance

- Scenario or fix ID:
- Owning Lico-Dev skill or workflow:
- Sanitized task receipts:
- Repository-owned checks:
- Independent Lico-Auditor status:

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one repository authority and closes its owning issue.
- [ ] Lico-Dev implemented one independently acceptable scenario closure and recorded durable evidence.
- [ ] The release classification matches the structured repository plan.
- [ ] Generated release documentation is current.
- [ ] Lico-Auditor remains an independent final gate; this change does not configure, weaken, or bypass it.
- [ ] Examples and evidence are synthetic or redacted.
- [ ] Packaging, GitHub Release, and external distribution claims remain separate.
